description: Declared PostgreSQL planar geometric columns retain their type semantics regardless of column name
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_geometric_spatial_boundary (id int4 PRIMARY KEY, geometry point NOT NULL, bounds box NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_geometric_spatial_boundary VALUES (1, point(1,2), '(0,0),(4,5)'), (2, point(6,7), '(5,6),(8,9)');
SELECT id, geometry, pg_typeof(geometry), bounds, pg_typeof(bounds) FROM type_matrix_geometric_spatial_boundary ORDER BY id;
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_geometric_spatial_boundary_gist ON type_matrix_geometric_spatial_boundary USING gist (geometry);
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_geometric_spatial_boundary WHERE geometry << point(5, 0) ORDER BY id;
UPDATE type_matrix_geometric_spatial_boundary SET geometry = point(3,4) WHERE id = 1;
SELECT id, geometry FROM type_matrix_geometric_spatial_boundary ORDER BY id;
